classification: IndexedDB emulation, real application storage and transaction code
checks: legacy migration assigns stable message IDs, preserves source and separate initial profile
new profiles isolate every database and renaming preserves stable identity
reload restores selection/preferences; active tasks block switching and deletion across tabs
complete JSON restore preserves IDs, document versions, binary originals, vectors, annotations and exact query snapshots
invalid import performs no writes and preserves active data
failure after staging both databases never activates a partial restore
quota failure opening staged research storage closes handles and leaves active profile untouched
legacy vectors without recorded revision are not silently reused on restore
omitted originals/vectors are explicit; pending data stays out of semantic retrieval
identical records deduplicate on merge; atomic generation pointer keeps profile identity
stale tabs must reload after restore and deletion requires exact confirmation
limitations: Not a browser visual, GPU or accessibility-technology test.
Model calls use deterministic unit vectors solely to test persistence.
